name: 연 · 저승길 차림
outfit: 짙은 청록색과 금색 자수가 놓인 한복풍 의복
silhouette: 아홉 개의 꼬리 뒤로 불꽃이 흩날리는 형태, 큼직한 여우 귀
signature_vfx: 아홉 개의 밝은 주황색 불꽃이 캐릭터 주변을 회전하며 적을 타격함
unique_features: 아홉 개의 꼬리 수만큼 떠다니는 여우불
visual_en: A small 2-head tall chibi fox-demon facing right. The character has deep navy hair and sharp bright gold eyes. They wear a rich teal green traditional hanbok with intricate gold embroidery and crimson red shoes. Behind them, nine large, voluminous tails fan out, each accompanied by a floating, vivid orange fox-fire orb. Tiny magical golden particles drift around the body. The silhouette is distinct with large fox ears and the swirling pattern of nine tails and orbiting flames.
features_en: Nine fox-fire orbs corresponding to each tail
Floating magical elements around the body

Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing regally while commanding floating flames with a confident gaze.
vfx_en: Nine bright orange and golden flame orbs orbiting the character rapidly.
lore: 구미호 반요 — 꼬리 수만큼 여우불을 띄운다. 무기 여우불.
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

parent_body.body: A humanoid fox character with blue hair, wearing a green and red robe, featuring multiple large orange tails.

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.

anim_notes.skill: The character's face stays clearly visible and lit with both eyes showing, not covered or darkened by the effect, flames or smoke. Only the character and its effect on an empty background: no walls, arches, doorways, portals, pillars or floor behind it
